objective: Work backward from a failed goal, connect a cause to a prevention, compare rehearsal evidence, and still test whether the positive goal happened.
authored_rules: Loaded cargo spills if hatch is open
Sleeping destination beacon sends rocket to QuietMoon
Only closed loaded cargo at MoonGarden meets the delivery goal
Badge straightening and casing polish have no delivery effect
observable_sequence: Compare rehearsal result with delivery goal and saved prediction

taxonomy_coverage.claim: Identify weaknesses from supplied fictional rehearsal outcomes
Use outcome evidence to choose and test a design improvement

assumed_prerequisites: Distinguish a goal from a means
prerequisite_mastery: Unknown; exact closure is recorded as background in the generated plan, not silently taught or inferred from age/IQ.
prediction_evidence: Saved component prediction compared with pre-repair consequence; completion does not rewrite it.
not_assessed: Learner transfer or general inversion mastery
sources_reviewed: Exact local taxonomy topic, evidence and prerequisites
source_limitations: Historical Munger attribution in the local research relies on an unofficial transcript mirror. This lesson uses no quotation or invention claim; causal rules are explicitly fictional, not scientific or empirical psychology claims.

tool_decisions.threejs: Requested 3D toy world, hinged cargo, depth, distinct destinations and direct component inspection
tool_decisions.gsap: Skippable causal flight presentation; no domain updates in callbacks
tool_decisions.html_css: One question and commit at a time, keyboard equivalents, goal/outcome comparison and focus management
tool_decisions.blender: Not needed for procedural toy geometry
